source_text:
19.8 Ου τοι ἐν α ρμασι
καὶ ου τοι ἐν ι πποις.
Νόει καί ι ππους τὰ σκιρτήματα τῶν πα θῶν, εἰς [οι ς]
ἐπιβαίνουσιν οἱ δαίμονες· α ρ ματα δὲ τὴν σύμπνοιαν τῶν ὁρμητικῶν πα θῶν, ἐν οι ς
παρασκευάζονται καθ' ἡμῶν.
pass_a_gloss: These in chariots and these in horses. Understand also horses the skippings of-the passions, into which mount the demons; chariots and the joint-breathing of-the impulsive passions, in which they-are-prepared against us.
pass_b_english: “These in chariots and these in horses” (Psalm 19:8).
Understand horses also as the skippings of the passions, upon which the demons mount; and chariots as the concerted breathing of the impulsive passions, in which they make ready against us.

choices.english: horses as the skippings of the passions
choices.why: ἵπποι are not literal cavalry only. OCR ι ππους / πα θῶν.

choices.term: ἅρματα δὲ τὴν σύμπνοιαν τῶν ὁρμητικῶν παθῶν
choices.english: chariots as the concerted breathing of the impulsive passions
choices.why: σύμπνοια is joint-breathing of the passions, not a wooden wagon. OCR α ρ ματα.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
